messages.content: Perform only the requested narrow semantic task. Return valid JSON only.

Choose chapter boundaries only from numbered authoritative source units.

1. A survey team finishes its field work at a remote site.
2. Three months later, the team reunites in a city laboratory.
3. They begin analyzing the collected material.
4. The analysis continues through several related tests.

A chapter is a LARGE H3 refresh unit. Use as few boundaries as the narrative permits. Major time/location/state resets can justify a new chapter.

Return a JSON object with key "new_chapter_after", an array of source-unit numbers. Do not include the final unit number.
